description: This Java test source file contains integration tests for the Tenant AMQP endpoint of the Device Registry component in the Eclipse Hono project. It sets up and tears down test resources, and includes tests that verify tenant-related functionality via the Tenant API.

classes.name: TenantAmqpIT
classes.description: Integration test class for Tenant AMQP endpoint in the Device Registry.
